products.name: Splice
products.note: Mobile video editing; music licensing; content creation; GoPro ownership

profile_text.body:
Splice describes itself as a royalty-free sample library, offering what it calls the industry's highest quality collection of sounds made by top artists, labels, and sound designers. The platform provides access to millions of samples, presets, and sound effects, and its catalog is positioned toward music producers looking for material to incorporate into original work. Splice also distributes software through a partnership with Xfer Records, featuring Xfer's wavetable synthesizer reborn with what the company describes as fresh features and workflow enhancements.

Beyond the core sample library, Splice offers several tools built around its catalog. The Sounds Plugin, currently in beta, brings the sample library directly into a digital audio workstation, allowing users to search, preview, and drag and drop sounds without leaving their project. Splice Mobile is a companion app that lets users discover and record song ideas on the go, with the ability to export stems to a DAW or share with collaborators.

The site's held facts categorize Splice under video generation and editing, noting connections to mobile video editing, music licensing, content creation, and GoPro ownership, though the company's own website at the time of harvesting focuses entirely on its audio and music production offerings. No litigation, regulatory filings, or patent records appear in the available data.
